findings: W1-1 (bug, w1-env-builds, open 2026-11-09): an environment build only advances while a client streams GET …/builds/:id/events. Polling GET …/builds/:id every 10 s (documented as also advancing the build) left the build in running with 0 log bytes for 25 min, and again for 4 min in a minimal repro. The same build finished in 15–19 s once the events stream was opened. API, CLI and MCP clients that poll, or a desktop that closes Settings mid-build, stall builds. The harness now follows the events stream the way the desktop does.

D-1 (bug, core desktop, high): starting an Orca Cloud create before signing in, then signing in from the card, created a sandbox owned by the fallback dev user (desktop-dogfood), not the signed-in user. Keep-alive, Copy SSH Command and Delete then got not_found. Likely cause: getHostedSandboxConfig() caches the token for the app process and does not reset it on sign-in (src/main/hosted-sandbox/hosted-sandbox-config.ts).
